title: Numbering restarts odp 001
notes: real ODP list numbering: text:list-style "L1" in styles.xml office:styles (level 1 text:list-level-style-number, text:num-format="1", text:start-value="1"), used by two text:list of 5 text:list-item > text:p inside the presentation:body frame; the second list carries text:continue-numbering="false" so its counter restarts at 1 (same list machinery as the odt numbering-restarts fixture, placed on a slide). ODF restart semantics stated honestly: text:continue-numbering DEFAULTS to false, so a sibling text:list sharing a list-style does not continue the previous counter anyway — the explicit text:continue-numbering="false" pins it (continuation would require "true"). Reference text is the 10 exact item strings plus the deck title; the number markers are render-derived, never in the file as text. No normative counter matches list elements, so the only nonzero counter is draw:frame=2.
